snapshot.text: Small public system with high maternal mortality: 130 maternal deaths were recorded in 2025. Falling immunisation coverage and health workforce gaps are current concerns.

priorities.title: Rescuing immunisation coverage
priorities.text: A high-level taskforce aims to reverse falling immunisation coverage.

priorities.title: Training more health workers
priorities.text: A $37.5 million deal to expand the university's School of Medicine, and a nursing capacity initiative.

priorities.title: Quality standards
priorities.text: New regulation to monitor standards in the health sector.
